transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because of the foreclosure. Everyone keeps acting like it's just... you know, paperwork. Missed payments. But I know what's really going on. 

The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. I don't really want to get into all of it right now, but... no amount of papers they try to show me changes what I’ve been seeing for almost two years. So... yeah. That's why.
Do you think someone is intentionally trying to harm you or your interests?

I mean... I thought I just explained that. Yes. It's not an accident. 

They're doing it on purpose. They all act like it's just normal paperwork or... or missed payments, but it's not. The bank, those people at my job... they are actively working together to take my house. I've been watching it happen for two years. So... yes. They are. 

I'd rather not say much more about it right now.
Have you had these thoughts about the bank and your job working against you continuously over the past two years, or have they come and gone?

It's... it's been constant. About a year and nine months, I guess. Ever since the foreclosure notices started coming and the bank wouldn't stop calling. It just... took over everything at home. So, no. It hasn't stopped.
Have you felt like other people or groups are out to harm you, beyond just the bank and your job?
No. Just... just the people I already told you about. I haven't noticed anyone else. That's enough, isn't it?
Have you had any other thoughts that you think are true, but others might not believe?
I don't... no. I don't know what you mean by that. I've just been dealing with the house and the bank. That's all.
Do you ever find it difficult to express your thoughts clearly or in a way that others can understand?
No. I... people understand me fine. I just... I tell them what's happening. If they don't get it, it's because they're not listening. But my words are clear.
Do you often feel like your thoughts are disjointed or hard to follow when you're thinking about the situation with your house?
No. My thoughts are... they're fine. I know exactly what's going on with the house. It's not confusing to me at all.
Have you done anything differently in your daily life because of what you believe is happening with the bank and your house?

No, not really. I still get up and go to work. I supervise my team, handle the schedules, deal with the customers... I take care of myself just fine. 

It's just... if I get certain mail, or the bank calls, or if there's paperwork at work that looks tied to the house... that's when things get complicated. I have to deal with it then. But otherwise, no. My daily life is normal.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
No. I don't... I don't hear voices. Just regular sounds.
Have you ever considered the possibility that the bank and your job might not be working together against you?

No. I haven't. Because... well, I know what I've been seeing. 

Everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just... normal paperwork. Like it's just about missed payments. But it's not. The bank, the loan servicer... and yes, people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. 

They can show me all the papers they want. It doesn't change what I know is happening. It's been going on for almost two years now. So... no, I haven't considered that.
Has there been any information or evidence that could potentially change your mind about the bank and your job working against you?

No. Like I just said... no. 

Everyone keeps acting like this is all just about missed payments and standard paperwork. But... no amount of papers they try to show me is going to change what I know. I've been seeing it happen for almost two years. So... no. There isn't.
Would anything be able to convince you that the bank and your job are not working together against you?

I feel like I just answered this. No. Nothing. 

I already told you... no amount of papers they show me is going to change my mind. I know what I've been seeing. I know they're working together to push me out. It's been two years. So... no.
Do you ever feel like things you see or hear on TV, radio, or in the newspaper are specifically about you or directed at you?
No. Not really. I just... watch the news like anyone else. It's just the news. I don't know why you're asking me that.
Are there any circumstances under which you could imagine changing your mind about the bank and your job working against you?

I... I really don't understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. 

I already told you. No. There are no circumstances. The bank, the loan servicer, the people at my work... they've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. I know what I know. Please stop asking me that.
Is there any small part of you that doubts your beliefs about the bank and your job working against you?

No. I don't doubt it. 

I don't know why everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just... paperwork. Like it's just about missed payments. It's not. The bank, the loan servicer... people at my job... they're working together. They want me out of my house. 

I've been seeing it happen for almost two years. So, no. I don't doubt it.
